title: Level 4 (Expert) - D-20
notes:
West leads the ♥8 against 4♠. West's heart opening lead is won by South with the ♥A and the dummy's ♣A and ♣K are cashed for a heart discard. South should plan to go after a diamond ruff in dummy, but if he does so at once the contract will fail in the above layout.

East will win the first round of diamonds and cash a heart trick while West discards a club. East will lead another heart which South must ruff high while West discards his remaining club. South continues with a second diamond to East and must ruff East's heart return high.

South can now ruff a diamond in the dummy and attempt to draw trump. East discards on the second round of spades and South cannot afford to overtake with the ♠A. Dummy will have only clubs remaining and West's remaining trump will be promoted into a winner to defeat the contract.

The solution is for South to ruff a club small in hand after cashing the ♣A and ♣K. This play allows South to win a trick with a small trump before West has a chance to discard his clubs. South exits in diamonds to East who cashes a heart trick and plays a third round which South ruffs high. East wins the second round of diamonds and leads another heart, South ruffing high.

South is now in a position to ruff his diamond loser in dummy. The dummy's 2 remaining high trumps will take care of South's 2 remaining small trumps and the ♠A will be left for the last trick.
